settings.hero_description: New England Cupboard is a specialty food mix manufacturer and distributor located in Hermon, Maine. New England Cupboard was founded in 1995 and is currently owned and operated by Jim Collins, of Hampden, Maine.

settings.title: Story
settings.description: New England Cupboard was founded in 1995 and is located in Hermon, Maine. The company is currently owned and operated by Jim Collins of Hampden, Maine. They are known for their Bakewell Cream line, Winterport Company Dips and Mixes, Jimbo's Seasonings, Jakes Treats, and Cook In The Kitchen products. Jim Collins started Jimbo's Spice Rubs after experimenting and creating his own spice rubs that his friends enjoyed. He later expanded his business by partnering with Diane from New England Cupboard, eventually purchasing the company. They have since acquired other smaller companies, including Winterport Co., Cook In The Kitchen, and the popular Bakewell Cream.

settings.title: Process
settings.description: New England Cupboard manufactures their food mixes in a 5,400-square-foot facility in Hermon, Maine. They have been making some of their mixes since their founding in 1995. They use all-natural ingredients and their products contain no preservatives.

settings.title: Specialty
settings.description:
New England Cupboard specializes in a wide variety of baking mixes, dip mixes, seasonings, and other related products. Their baking mixes include options for:
cookies, scones, muffins, desserts, savory breads, gluten-free mixes. They are particularly known for their Original Bakewell Cream and Winterport Co. baking and dip mixes. Their Bakewell Cream is a variety of baking powder developed in the 1940s as a substitute for cream of tartar during wartime shortages. They also offer pancake and waffle mixes in flavors like wild cranberry, true blueberry, maple buttermilk, and apple spice.

settings.title: What Makes Them Different
settings.description: New England Cupboard stands out from other food mix companies due to its emphasis on all-natural ingredients and avoidance of preservatives. With deep Maine roots, they focus on local product families like Jimbo's Seasonings and Bakewell Cream. Customers praise the quality of their products, particularly the Bakewell Cream, which creates excellent biscuits without an aftertaste. The company also prioritizes customer satisfaction and offers an online shopping experience by appointment only.
